---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new developer utility, conversion mode, or UI improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

### Feature Summary
A concise description of the suggested utility or enhancement.

### Developer Problem / Use Case
What developer workflow pain point does this address? (e.g., "Currently converting timestamps requires external ad-heavy websites; an offline client-side tool solves this").

### Proposed Technical Solution
Describe your envisioned implementation:
- Input specifications (format, size limits)
- Processing logic (standard library or minimal dependencies)
- Output formats (copy, download, export)

### Alternative Approaches
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Privacy & Ephemeral Processing
Confirm that this feature can execute in-memory client-side without storing user data:
- [ ] Confirmed zero-storage / privacy-first design
